item.title: Louis Zocchi, inventor of the d100, has died
item.description:
📝 LOUIS ZOCCHI, THE GODFATHER OF DICE Founder of Zocchi Distribution, Gamescience, and Creator of Zocchihedron Posted by Jeffrey Dohm-Sanchez on April 20, 2026 @ 8:39 am CT Games industry pioneer and legend Louis Zocchi passed away on April 15, 2026. Zocchi founded Gamescience in 1974. Zocchi was also in the distribution end of the games business; he was the founder of Zocchi Distribution, later renamed Zocchi Distributing (see “Zocchi Distributing“).
